import sys,json,hashlib,types,copy,time
from pathlib import Path
S=Path('/home/user/src/work-leaf/bench-results/efficiency-mechanism-isolation-20260906T214448Z')
P=S/'phases/candidate-screen-01'
sp=S/'CANDIDATE-COMMON-ACCOUNTING-SCOPE.json'
scope_sha='e060a08f3c3c79a4fcd43647f91132f05431ab2a3fd1fe544d6de7afd26bd6ee'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
canon=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
assert sha(sp.read_bytes())==scope_sha
scope=json.loads(sp.read_bytes())
def verify_ref(r):
 p=Path(r['path']); assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(),str(p)
 assert sha(p.read_bytes())==r['sha256'],str(p)
for k in ['accounting_helper','helper_identity_manifest','candidate_score_manifest','retained_control_score_manifest','retained_control_phase_manifest','current_final_outcomes']:
 verify_ref(scope[k])
for r in scope['dependencies']+scope['source_and_compatibility']:verify_ref(r)
frozen=json.loads(Path(scope['helper_identity_manifest']['path']).read_bytes())
files=frozen['files']
assert len(files)==105,len(files)
for r in files: verify_ref(r)
h=Path(scope['accounting_helper']['path'])
code=h.read_bytes()
m=types.ModuleType('common_original_replay');m.__file__=str(h);sys.modules[m.__name__]=m
exec(compile(code,str(h),'exec'),m.__dict__)
rid=sys.argv[1]
scoped=[r for r in scope['rows'] if r['run_id']==rid];assert len(scoped)==1
key='candidate_score_manifest' if rid in scope['modified_run_ids'] else 'retained_control_score_manifest'
rows=json.loads(Path(scope[key]['path']).read_bytes())['runs']
entries=[r for r in rows if r['run_id']==rid];assert len(entries)==1
entry=entries[0]
assert all(entry.get(k)==v for k,v in scoped[0].items()),rid
started=time.time()
full=m.audit_run(entry,frozen,Path(scope['sessions_root']))
full_sha=sha(canon(full))
exact=full['exact_response_evidence']
ownership={key:{'thread_id':value.get('thread_id'),'turn_id':value.get('turn_id')} for key,value in exact.items()}
a=copy.deepcopy(full)
a['exact_helper_result_sha256']=full_sha
a['exact_response_evidence']={'count':len(exact),'sha256':sha(canon(exact)),'retention':'Exact records retained in pinned raw/native sources and reproducible unchanged helper result; not duplicated here.'}
gap=a.get('measurement',{}).get('gap_inventory')
if isinstance(gap,dict) and 'raw_responses' in gap:
 raw=gap.pop('raw_responses');gap['raw_response_inventory_identity']={'count':len(raw),'sha256':sha(canon(raw))}
corrected=a.get('corrected_scope')
if isinstance(corrected,dict):
 for c in corrected.get('captures',[]):
  if 'proof_view_server_lines' in c:
   proof=c.pop('proof_view_server_lines');c['proof_view_server_lines_identity']={'count':len(proof),'sha256':sha(canon(proof)),'retention':'Original physical source and deterministic frozen predicate retained; no rewritten stream.'}
receipt={'scope_sha256':scope_sha,'kind':'run','original_entry':entry,'accounting':a}
checks={'scope_row_equals_score_manifest':True,'frozen_input_count':len(files),'frozen_inputs_start_match':True}
existing=P/'postcapture'/rid/'COMMON-ACCOUNTING-ORIGINAL.json'
if rid in scope['modified_run_ids']:
 saved=json.loads(existing.read_bytes())
 checks['existing_full_helper_result_sha256_match']=saved['accounting']['exact_helper_result_sha256']==full_sha
 checks['existing_projection_structurally_equal']=saved==receipt
 checks['existing_receipt']={'path':str(existing),'sha256':sha(existing.read_bytes())}
 assert checks['existing_full_helper_result_sha256_match'],(rid,'fullsha',full_sha,saved['accounting']['exact_helper_result_sha256'])
 assert checks['existing_projection_structurally_equal'],(rid,'projection mismatch')
else:
 assert not (P/'postcapture/retained-baselines'/rid/'COMMON-ACCOUNTING-ORIGINAL.json').exists()
for path,digest in full['source_sha256'].items():
 assert sha(Path(path).read_bytes())==digest,path
checks['returned_source_count']=len(full['source_sha256']);checks['returned_sources_endpoint_match']=True
for r in files:verify_ref(r)
checks['frozen_inputs_endpoint_match']=True
checks['elapsed_seconds']=round(time.time()-started,3)
print(json.dumps({'receipt':receipt,'response_ownership':ownership,'checks':checks},separators=(',',':')))
